recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Adding source text would duplicate existing guidance or reintroduce obsolete compose.import terminology; no follow-up is needed in core for FHIR-5555.
issue_request: FHIR-5555 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core ValueSet change request to clarify ValueSet.compose.import: the URI should be absolute, should be a logical reference to ValueSet.url rather than a search or $expand URL, and expansion should resolve and expand imported value sets recursively with include/exclude processing.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 4579, preserved as git commit 2cdbc5b35a66ab715da349dd043931559bae87f4, which added ValueSet import URI wording and recursive expansion guidance. That guidance was later carried forward as compose.import was refactored.
additional_context: FHIR-9535 moved ValueSet.compose.import into ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet and documented intersection/union behavior. FHIR-9828 corrected ValueSet.uri to ValueSet.url, FHIR-18075 fixed stale compose.import narrative, FHIR-5784 chose not to split URI and Reference forms and pointed back to FHIR-5555, and FHIR-5783 added related version-specific logical reference guidance. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml defines ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet as an absolute/canonical reference to ValueSet.url with logical/direct/implicit resolution. Current source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml says expansion finds referenced value sets by ValueSet.url, expands them with $expand using compose.include.valueSet, handles the process recursively, intersects value sets within one include, unions includes, and removes exclusions.
source_changes: No source changes; current build-scoped ValueSet source already satisfies the clarified rule.
